tokens.name: slider/track-padding
tokens.description: Inset of tick edges: slider/inset (24) minus half tick width (1). Tick centers therefore match the app's 24px inset.

tokens.name: slider/secondary-weight
tokens.description: Lighter supporting labels: Matter Regular 400, contrasted with selected minutes SemiBold 600.

components.name: Minutes=5
components.description: TimeSlider(value, onChange, disabled?). 5–60+ minutes in five-minute stops. 60+ is uncapped. Reference width 362; instances Fill container. Linear positions: (minutes - 5) / 55. 12 ruler marks, each representing one selectable five-minute step. Selected minutes: SemiBold 600; Mins and endpoints: lighter Regular 400. Figma: press and sweep across targets, or click/tap a stop. Mouse-up/leave ends dragging. Expo: pointer/touch drag snapped to five minutes, keyboard and accessibility adjustment. Figma touch drag uses previous/next halves of the focused stop; continuous pointer-following and release snapping are implemented in Expo. Prototype drag behavior requires a Present-mode/device check.
